_readme: Farmers, flea and night markets, verified against each operator's own page on 2026-10-14 (night markets partly from Funcheap listings). Each refresh turns these into dated, recurring events on Family outings. Fields: days, hours [start,end], optional months (season), nth (week of month; -1 = last), until (last date), dates (announced dates only). Update 'until' and 'dates' each season.
